limitations: No macOS hardware; current WSL2-to-Windows Chrome integration passed; full interactive acceptance was not repeated.
Old development was reused for exploratory nomination/selection, never fresh evidence.
D10/D12 are estimates before exact endings; bootstrap excludes systematic teacher bias.
B-generated source policies and B/L frontiers do not represent all human policies or P-selected frontiers.
The bounded L still has active constraints; P gains do not prove an unrestricted seven-feature optimum is unattainable.
Timed development probes include per-call clock overhead; scientific games do not.
Node CPU in the final manifest covers the last coordinator process; active wall time is accumulated across the resource pause.
Independent occupancy is sampled, with temporary engineering scaling pools documented separately.
